expected.notes: The plan has one time_zone for the whole system: the owner's, Asia/Kolkata (UTC+5:30, an odd offset). The browser pre-fill (America/New_York) must NOT win over the explicit answer. send_hour is an integer 0 to 23, so 9:30am cannot be expressed exactly; the planner uses send_hour 9 and notes the rounding in unsupported_requests. Per-person time zones are unsupported and are listed in unsupported_requests. The diff checks that unsupported_requests mentions time zones for this persona. Contributor names may contain an apostrophe (O'Brien) and must survive validation.
